verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክ፡ ለመሢሕየ፡ ቂሮስ፡ ዘአኀዝክዎ፡ በእዴየ፡ ከመ፡ አግርሮሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ ወእነፅኅ፡ ኃይለ፡ ነገሥት፤ ወአርኁ፡ አናቅጸ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ ወኢይትዐጸዋ፡ አህጉር።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord God to my anointed Cyrus, whose right hand I have held, that nations might be obedient before him; and I will break through the strength of kings; I will open doors before him, and cities shall not be closed.

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord God to my anointed Cyrus, whose right hand I have held, that nations might be obedient before him; and I will break through the strength of kings; I will open doors before him, and cities shall not be closed.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
translations.ron: Aşa zice Domnul unsului Său Cirus, pe care îl ţine de mâna lui cea dreaptă, ca să doboare neamurile înaintea lui şi ca să dezlege cingătorile regilor, să deschidă porţile înaintea lui şi ca ele să nu mai fie închise:
translations.grk: Οὕτῳ λέγει Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τῷ χριστῷ μου Κύρῳ, οὗ ἐκράτησα τῆς δεξιᾶς, ἐπακοῦσαι ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ ἔθνη, καὶ ἰσχὺν βασιλέων διαῤῥήξω, ἀνοίξω ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ θύρας, καὶ πόλεις οὐ συγκλεισθήσονται.

verses.geez: አነ፡ አሐውር፡ ፍጽመ፡ ቅድሜከ፡ ወአቴሕቶሙ፡ ለአድባር፣፡ ወእሰብር፡ አናቅጸ፡ ብርት፡ ወእቅጠቅጥ፡ መናሥግተ፡ ኀፂን።
verses.translation: I will go before thee, and will level mountains: I will break to pieces brazen doors, and will burst iron bars.

translations.lxx: I will go before thee, and will level mountains: I will break to pieces brazen doors, and will burst iron bars.
translations.kjv: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
translations.ron: "Eu voi merge înaintea ta şi drumurile cele muntoase le voi netezi, voi zdrobi porţile cele de aramă şi zăvoarele cele de fier le voi sfărâma.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ ἔμπροσθέν σου πορεύσομαι, καὶ ὄρη ὁμαλιῶ, θύρας χαλκᾶς συντρίψω, καὶ μοχλοὺς σιδηροῦς συνκλάσω.

verses.geez: ወእሁበከ፡ መዛግብተ፡ ኅቡአ፡ ወክቡተ፤ ዘኢያስተርኢ፡ እከሥት፡ ለከ፡ ከመ፡ ታእምር፡ ከመ፡ አነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘሰመይኩ፡ ስመከ፣፡ አምላከ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, I will open to thee hidden, unseen treasures, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord thy God, that call thee by name, am the God of Israel.

translations.lxx: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, I will open to thee hidden, unseen treasures, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord thy God, that call thee by name, am the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi îţi voi da ţie vistierii ascunse, bogăţii îngropate în pământ, ca să ştii că Eu sunt Domnul Cel Care te-a chemat pe nume, Eu sunt Dumnezeul lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ δώσω σοι θησαυροὺς σκοτεινοὺς, ἀποκρύφους, ἀοράτους ἀνοίξω σοι, ἵνα γνῷς ὅτι ἐγὼ Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου ὁ καλῶν τὸ ὄνομά σουὁ, Θεὸς Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ቍልዔየ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወእስራኤልኒ፡ ኅሩይየ፣፡ አነ፡ እጼውዐከ፡ በስምከ፡ ወእትዌከፈከ።
verses.translation: For the sake of my servant Jacob, and Israel mine elect, I will call thee by thy name, and accept thee: but thou hast not known me.

translations.lxx: For the sake of my servant Jacob, and Israel mine elect, I will call thee by thy name, and accept thee: but thou hast not known me.
translations.kjv: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
translations.ron: Pentru sluga Mea Iacov şi pentru Israel, alesul Meu, te-am chemat pe nume şi un nume de cinste i-am dat fără ca tu să Mă ştii.
translations.grk: Ἕνεκεν τοῦ παιδός μου Ἰακὼβ, καὶ Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ ἐκλεκτοῦ μου, ἐγὼ καλέσω σε τῷ ὀνόματί σου, καὶ προσδέξομαί σε· σὺ δὲ οὐκ ἔγνως με,

verses.geez: ከመ፡ አነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክከ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ባዕድ፡ አምላክ፡ ዘእንበሌየ።
verses.translation: For I am the Lord God, and there is no other God beside me; I strengthened thee, and thou hast not known me.

translations.lxx: For I am the Lord God, and there is no other God beside me; I strengthened thee, and thou hast not known me.
translations.kjv: I am the LORD, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
translations.ron: Eu sunt Domnul şi nimeni altul! Afară de Mine nu este Dumnezeu. Eu te-am încins fără ca tu să Mă cunoşti.
translations.grk: ὅτι ἐγὼ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι πλὴν ἐμοῦ Θεός· ἐνίσχυσά σε, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδεις με,

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ያእምሩ፡ እለ፡ እምሥራቀ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወእለሂ፡ እምዕራብ፡ ከመ፡ አልቦ፡ ባዕድ፡ አምላክ፡ ዘእንበሌየ።
verses.translation: That they that come from the east and they that come from the west may know that there is no God but me. I am the Lord God, and there is none beside.

translations.lxx: That they that come from the east and they that come from the west may know that there is no God but me. I am the Lord God, and there is none beside.
translations.kjv: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the LORD, and there is none else.
translations.ron: Ca să se ştie de la răsărit şi până la apus că nu este nimic afară de Mine! Eu sunt Domnul şi nimeni altul!
translations.grk: ἵνα γνῶσιν οἱ ἀπʼ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου καὶ οἱ ἀπὸ δυσμῶν, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστι Θεὸς πλὴν ἐμοῦ· ἐγὼ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι.

verses.geez: አነ፡ ፈጠርኩ፡ ብርሃነ፡ ወገብርኩ፡ ጽልመተ፤ አነ፡ እፈጥር፡ ሰላመ፡ ወአመጽእ፡ እኪተ።
verses.translation: I am he that prepared light, and formed darkness; who make peace, and create evil; I am the Lord God, that does all these things.

translations.lxx: I am he that prepared light, and formed darkness; who make peace, and create evil; I am the Lord God, that does all these things.
translations.kjv: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things.
translations.ron: Eu întocmesc lumina şi dau chip întunericului, Cel ce sălăşluieşte pacea şi restriştei îi lasă cale: Eu sunt Domnul Care fac toate acestea.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ ἡ κατασκευάσας φῶς, καὶ ποιήσας σκότος, ὁ ποιῶν εἰρήνην, καὶ κτίζων κακά· ἐγὼ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς, ὁ ποιῶν πάντα ταῦτα.

verses.geez: ትትፌሣሕ፡ ሰማይ፡ በላዕሉ፡ ወይነሰንሳ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ደመናት፣፡ ወታበቍል፡ ምድር፡ ወታበቍል፡ ሣህለ፡ ወርቱዐ፡ ኅቡረ፤ አነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክ፡ ዘፈጠርኩከ።
verses.translation: Let the heaven rejoice from above, and let the clouds rain righteousness: let the earth bring forth, and blossom with mercy, and bring forth righteousness likewise: I am the Lord that created thee.

translations.lxx: Let the heaven rejoice from above, and let the clouds rain righteousness: let the earth bring forth, and blossom with mercy, and bring forth righteousness likewise: I am the Lord that created thee.
translations.kjv: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.
translations.ron: Picuraţi rouă de sus, voi ceruri, şi norii să reverse în ploaie dreptatea! Pământul să se deschidă şi să odrăslească mântuirea şi dreptatea să dea mlădiţe laolaltă: Eu, Domnul, am zidit toate acestea!
translations.grk: Εὐφρανθήτω ὁ οὐρανὸς ἄνωθεν, καὶ αἱ νεφέλαι ῥανάτωσαν δικαιοσύνην· ἀνατειλάτω ἡ γῆ, καὶ βλαστησάτω ἔλεος, καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἀνατειλάτω ἅμα· ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος ὁ κτίσας σε.

verses.geez: ወአኅየስኩከ፡ ወገበርኩከ፡ ከመ፡ ጽቡረ፡ ለብሐዊ፤ ቦኑ፡ ኵሎ፡ አሚረ፡ የሐርስ፡ ዘየሐርስ፡ ምድረ፤ ቦኑ፡ ዘይብሎ፡ ጽቡር፡ ለለብሐዊ፤ ምንተ፡ ትገብር፡ እስመ፡ ኢትክል፡ ገቢረ፡ ወአልብከ፡ እደወ፤ ይትዋሥኦኑ፡ ጽቡር፡ ለለሐኲሁ።
verses.translation: What excellent thing have I prepared as clay of the potter? Will the ploughman plough the earth all day? shall the clay say to the potter, What art thou doing that thou dost not work, nor hast hands? shall the thing formed answer him that formed it?

translations.lxx: What excellent thing have I prepared as clay of the potter? Will the ploughman plough the earth all day? shall the clay say to the potter, What art thou doing that thou dost not work, nor hast hands? shall the thing formed answer him that formed it?
translations.kjv: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
translations.ron: Vai de cel ce se ceartă cu Ziditorul său, ciob printre hârburile de pământ! Oare lutul zice olarului: "Ce faci tu?" Şi lucrul către meşter: "Tu nu eşti iscusit!"
translations.grk: Ποῖον βέλτιον κατεσκεύασα ὡς πηλὸν κεραμέως; μὴ ὁ ἀροτριῶν ἀροτριάσει τὴν γῆν ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν; μὴ ἐρεῖ ὁ πηλὸς τῷ κεραμεῖ, τί ποιεῖς ὅτι οὐκ ἐργάζῃ, οὐδὲ ἔχεις χεῖρας; μὴ ἀποκριθήσεται τὸ πλάσμα πρὸς τὸν πλάσαντα αὐτό;

verses.geez: አሌሎ፡ ለዘይብሎ፡ ለአቡሁ፤ ምንተ፡ ወለድከኒ፤ ወለእሙኒ፤ ምንትኑመ፡ ማሕምምኪ።
verses.translation: As though one should say to his father, What wilt thou beget me? and to his mother, What art thou bringing forth?

translations.lxx: As though one should say to his father, What wilt thou beget me? and to his mother, What art thou bringing forth?
translations.kjv: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
translations.ron: Vai de cel ce zice către părinte: "Pentru ce dai naştere?" şi femeii: "Pentru ce ai copii?"
translations.grk: Ὁ λέγων τῷ πατρὶ, τί γεννήσεις; καὶ τῇ μητρί, τί ὠδίνεις;

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክ፣፡ ቅዱሰ፡ እስራኤል፡ ዘገብረ፡ ዘይመጽእ፤ ተሰአሉኒ፡ በእንተ፡ ደቂቅየ፡ ወአዋልድየ፣፡ ወበእንተ፡ ግብረ፡ እደውየ፡ አዝዙኒ።
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, who has formed the things that are to come, Enquire of me concerning my sons, and concerning the works of my hands command me.

translations.lxx: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, who has formed the things that are to come, Enquire of me concerning my sons, and concerning the works of my hands command me.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
translations.ron: Aşa zice Domnul, Sfântul lui Israel şi Ziditorul său: "Îndrăzniţi voi oare să Mă întrebaţi despre cele viitoare şi să daţi poruncă lucrului mâinilor Mele?
translations.grk: Ὅτι οὕτω λέγει Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ὁ ἅγιος Ἰσραὴλ, ὁ ποιήσας τὰ ἐπερχόμενα, ἐρωτήσατέ με περὶ τῶν υἱῶν μου, καὶ περὶ τῶν ἔργων τῶν χειρῶν μου ἐντείλασθέ μοι.

verses.geez: አነ፡ ፈጠርክዋ፡ ለምድር፡ ወሰብአ፡ ዲቤሃ፤ አነ፡ በእዴየ፡ አጽናዕክዎ፡ ለሰማይ፤ አነ፡ አዘዝክዎሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ከዋክብት።
verses.translation: I have made the earth, and man upon it: I with my hand have established the heaven; I have given commandment to all the stars.

translations.lxx: I have made the earth, and man upon it: I with my hand have established the heaven; I have given commandment to all the stars.
translations.kjv: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
translations.ron: Eu am făcut pământul şi omul de pe el Eu l-am zidit. Eu cu mâinile am întins cerurile şi la toată oştirea lor Eu îi dau poruncă.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ ἐποίησα γῆν, καὶ ἄνθρωπον ἐπʼ αὐτῆς, ἐγὼ τῇ χειρί μου ἐστερέωσα τὸν οὐρανὸν, ἐγὼ πᾶσι τοῖς ἄστροις ἐνετειλάμην.

verses.geez: ወአነ፡ አንሣእክዎ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወበርትዕ፡ ወሠራኅኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፍኖቶ፤ ወውእቱ፡ የሐንጽ፡ ሀገርየ፡ ወይመይጥ፡ ፄዋ፡ ሕዝብየ፣፡ አኮ፡ በቤዛ፡ ወአኮ፡ በሕልያን፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት።
verses.translation: I have raised him up to be a king with righteousness, and all his ways are right: he shall build my city, and shall turn the captivity of my people, not for ransoms, nor for rewards, saith the Lord of hosts.

translations.lxx: I have raised him up to be a king with righteousness, and all his ways are right: he shall build my city, and shall turn the captivity of my people, not for ransoms, nor for rewards, saith the Lord of hosts.
translations.kjv: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the LORD of hosts.
translations.ron: Eu l-am ridicat întru dreptatea Mea şi toate căile lui le voi netezi. El va zidi cetatea Mea şi va libera pe robii Mei, fără răscumpărare şi fără daruri", zice Domnul Savaot.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ ἤγειρα αὐτὸν μετὰ δικαιοσύνης βασιλέα, καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ εὐθεῖαι· οὗτος οἰκοδομήσει τὴν πόλιν μου, καὶ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τοῦ λαοῦ μου ἐπιστρέψει, οὐ μετὰ λύτρων, οὐδὲ μετὰ δώρων, εἶπε Κύριος σαβαώθ.

verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፤ ሰርሑ፡ ግብጽ፡ ወአህጉረ፡ ኢትዮጵያ፣፡ ወሰብአ፡ ሳባዕ፡ ዕደው፡ ነዋኅት፡ ይመጽኡ፡ ኀቤከ፣፡ ወይትቀነዩ፡ ለከ፡ ወይተልዉ፡ ድኅሬከ፡ እንዘ፡ ሙቁሓን፡ እደዊሆሙ፣፡ ወይሰግዱ፡ ለከ፡ ወይጼልዩ፡ ኀቤከ፤ እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ባዕደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘእንበሌከ።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Egypt has laboured for thee; and the merchandise of the Ethiopians, and the Sabeans, men of stature, shall pass over to thee, and shall be thy servants; and they shall follow after thee bound in fetters, and shall pass over to thee, and shall do obeisance to thee, and make supplication to thee: because God is in thee; and there is no God beside thee, O Lord.

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Egypt has laboured for thee; and the merchandise of the Ethiopians, and the Sabeans, men of stature, shall pass over to thee, and shall be thy servants; and they shall follow after thee bound in fetters, and shall pass over to thee, and shall do obeisance to thee, and make supplication to thee: because God is in thee; and there is no God beside thee, O Lord.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.
translations.ron: Aşa zice Domnul: "Bogăţiile Egiptului şi câştigurile Etiopiei şi ale Sabeenilor celor înalţi la stat vor trece la tine şi ai tăi vor fi; în lanţuri iţi vor sluji ţie şi vor cădea înaintea ta şi rugându-se ţie vor zice: "Numai tu ai un Dumnezeu tare, şi nu este alt dumnezeu afară de El.
translations.grk: Οὕτω λέγει Κύριος σαβαὼθ, ἐκοπίασεν Αἴγυπτος, καὶ ἐμπορία Αἰθιόπων, καὶ οἱ Σαβαεὶμ ἄνδρες ὑψηλοὶ ἐπὶ σὲ διαβήσονται, καὶ σοὶ ἔσονται δοῦλοι, καὶ ὀπίσω σου ἀκολουθήσουσι δεδεμένοι χειροπέδαις, καὶ διαβήσονται πρὸς σὲ, καὶ προσκυνήσουσί σοι, καὶ ἐν σοὶ προσεύξονται· ὅτι ἐν σοὶ ὁ Θεός ἐστι, καὶ οὐκ ἔστι Θεὸς πλήν σου.

verses.geez: አንተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወኢያእመርናከ፣፡ አምላከ፡ እስራኤል፡ ማሕየዊ።
verses.translation: For thou art God, yet we knew it not, the God of Israel, the Saviour.

translations.lxx: For thou art God, yet we knew it not, the God of Israel, the Saviour.
translations.kjv: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
translations.ron: Cu adevărat Tu eşti Dumnezeu ascuns, Dumnezeul lui Israel Cel izbăvitor!
translations.grk: Σὺ γὰρ εἶ Θεὸς, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδειμεν, ὁ Θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ σωρήρ.

verses.geez: ለይትኀፈሩ፡ ወይኀሠሩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይትቃወምዎ፡ ወይሖሩ፡ ተኀፊሮሙ።
verses.translation: All that are opposed to him shall be ashamed and confounded, and shall walk in shame: ye isles, keep a feast to me.

translations.lxx: All that are opposed to him shall be ashamed and confounded, and shall walk in shame: ye isles, keep a feast to me.
translations.kjv: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
translations.ron: Cei care se aprindeau împotriva Ta vor fi ruşinaţi şi umiliţi, făcătorii de idoli se vor face de râs.
translations.grk: Αἰσχυνθήσονται καὶ ἐντραπήσονται πάντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι αὐτῷ, καὶ πορεύσονται ἐν αἰσχύνῃ· ἐγκαινίζεσθε πρὸς μὲ νῆσοι.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ያድኅኖ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለእስራኤል፡ መድኃኒተ፡ ዘለዓለም፤ ኢይትኀፈሩ፡ ወኢየኀሥሩ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም።
verses.translation: Israel is saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation: they shall not be ashamed nor confounded for evermore.

translations.lxx: Israel is saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation: they shall not be ashamed nor confounded for evermore.
translations.kjv: But Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
translations.ron: Israel va fi izbăvit de Domnul cu mântuire veşnică. Voi nu veţi fi ruşinaţi, nici umiliţi în vecii vecilor!"
translations.grk: Ἰσραὴλ σώζεται ὑπὸ Κυρίου σωτηρίαν αἰώνιον· οὐκ αἰσχυνθήσονται, οὐδὲ μὴ ἐντραπῶσιν ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος ἔτι.

verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘገብረ፡ ሰማየ፣፡ ውእቱኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘአርአያ፡ ለምድር፡ ወገብራ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ሠጠቃ፤ አኮ፡ ለከንቱ፡ ዘገብራ፣፡ ዳእሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይንበሩ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ፈጠራ።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord that made the heaven, this God that created the earth, and made it; he marked it out, he made it not in vain, but formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord, and there is none beside.

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord that made the heaven, this God that created the earth, and made it; he marked it out, he made it not in vain, but formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord, and there is none beside.
translations.kjv: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the LORD; and there is none else.
translations.ron: Că aşa zice Domnul, Care a făcut cerurile, Dumnezeu, Care a întocmit pământul, l-a făcut şi l-a întărit; şi nu în deşert l-a făcut, ci ca să fie locuit: "Eu sunt Domnul şi nu este altul!"
translations.grk: Οὕτως λέγει Κύριος ὁ ποιήσας τὸν οὐρανὸν, οὗτος ὁ Θεὸς ὁ καταδείξας τὴν γῆν, καὶ ποιήσας αὐτὴν, αὐτὸς διώρισεν αὐτὴν, οὐκ εἰς κενὸν ἐποίησεν αὐτὴν, ἀλλὰ κατοικεῖσθαι ἔπλασεν αὐτὴν, ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι.

verses.geez: አኮ፡ ጽምሚተ፡ ዘተናገርኩ፡ ወአኮ፡ በብሔረ፡ ጽልመት፡ ዘነበብኩ።
verses.translation: I have not spoken in secret, nor in a dark place of the earth: I said not to the seed of Jacob, Seek vanity: I, even I, am the Lord, speaking righteousness, and proclaiming truth.

translations.lxx: I have not spoken in secret, nor in a dark place of the earth: I said not to the seed of Jacob, Seek vanity: I, even I, am the Lord, speaking righteousness, and proclaiming truth.
translations.kjv: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
translations.ron: N-am grăit acestea într-ascuns, undeva în vreun colţ întunecos al pământului; şi n-am zis fără rost neamului lui Iacov: "Căutaţi-Mă!" Eu sunt Domnul Cel ce grăieşte drept şi spune adevărul!
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐν κρυφῇ λελάληκα, οὐδὲ ἐν τόπῳ γῆς σκοτεινῷ· οὐκ εἶπα τῷ σπέρματι Ἰακὼβ, μάταιον ζητήσατε· ἐγώ εἰμι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος ὁ λαλῶν δικαιοσύνην, καὶ ἀναγγέλλων ἀλήθειαν.

verses.geez: ተጋብኡ፡ ወንዑ፡ ወተማከሩ፡ ኅቡረ፡ እለ፡ ድኅንክሙ፡ እምአሕዛብ።
verses.translation: Assemble yourselves and come; take counsel together, ye that escape of the nations: they that set up wood, even their graven image, have no knowledge, nor they who pray to gods that do not save.

translations.lxx: Assemble yourselves and come; take counsel together, ye that escape of the nations: they that set up wood, even their graven image, have no knowledge, nor they who pray to gods that do not save.
translations.kjv: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
translations.ron: Adunaţi-vă, veniţi, apropiaţi-vă laolaltă, cei rămaşi cu viaţă dintre neamuri! Nu îşi dau seama de nimic cei ce duc după ei un idol de lemn şi se închină unui dumnezeu care nu poate izbăvi!
translations.grk: Συνάχθητε, καὶ ἥκετε, βουλεύσασθε ἅμα οἱ σωζόμενοι ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν· οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οἱ αἴροντες τὸ ξύλον γλύμμα αὐτῶν, καὶ οἱ προσευχόμενοι πρὸς θεοὺς, οἳ οὐ σώζουσιν.

verses.geez: ወእመሰ፡ ይነግሩ፡ ይቅረቡ፡ ከመ፡ ያእምሩ፡ ኅቡረ፡ መኑ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ዘንተ፡ ስምዐ፡ እምትካት፤ ቦሁ፡ አመ፡ ነገሩክሙ፡ ከመ፡ አነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወአልቦ፡ ባዕደ፡ ዘእንበሌየ፤ ጻድቅ፡ ወማሕየዊ፡ ወአልቦ፡ እንተ፡ ከማየ።
verses.translation: If they will declare, let them draw nigh, that they may know together, who has caused these things to be heard from the beginning: then was it told you. I am God, and there is not another beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none but me.

translations.lxx: If they will declare, let them draw nigh, that they may know together, who has caused these things to be heard from the beginning: then was it told you. I am God, and there is not another beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none but me.
translations.kjv: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the LORD? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
translations.ron: Grăiţi, apropiaţi-vă şi sfătuiţi-vă unul cu altul! Cine a vestit aceasta, cine altădată a dat de ştire? Oare nu Eu Domnul? Nu este alt dumnezeu afară de Mine. Dumnezeu drept şi izbăvitor nu este altul decât Mine!
translations.grk: Εἰ ἀναγγελοῦσιν, ἐγγισάτωσαν, ἵνα γνῶσιν ἅμα, τίς ἀκουστὰ ἐποίησε ταῦτα ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· τότε ἀνηγγέλη ὑμῖν· ἐγὼ ὁ Θεὸς, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλος πλὴν ἐμοῦ· δίκαιος καὶ σωτὴρ, οὐκ ἔστι πάρεξ ἐμοῦ.

verses.geez: ተመየጡ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ወተሐይዉ፡ እለ፡ እምአጽናፈ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: Turn ye to me, and ye shall be saved, ye that come from the end of the earth: I am God, and there is none other.

translations.lxx: Turn ye to me, and ye shall be saved, ye that come from the end of the earth: I am God, and there is none other.
translations.kjv: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.
translations.ron: Întoarceţi-vă către Mine şi veţi fi mântuiţi, voi cei ce locuiţi toate ţinuturile cele mai îndepărtate ale pământului! Că Eu sunt Dumnezeu tare şi nu este altul!
translations.grk: Ἐπιστράφητε ἐπʼ ἐμὲ, καὶ σωθήσεσθε, οἱ ἀπʼ ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς· ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ Θεὸς, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλος.

verses.geez: መሐልኩ፡ በርእስየ፤ ኢይትመየጥ፡ ቃልየ፡ ዘወፅአ፡ እምአፉየ።
verses.translation: By myself I swear, righteousness shall surely proceed out of my mouth; my words shall not be frustrated; that to me every knee shall bend, and every tongue shall swear by God,

translations.lxx: By myself I swear, righteousness shall surely proceed out of my mouth; my words shall not be frustrated; that to me every knee shall bend, and every tongue shall swear by God,
translations.kjv: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
translations.ron: Am jurat pe Mine Însumi! Din gura Mea iese dreptatea şi nu-Mi întorc cuvântul; înaintea Mea tot genunchiul se va pleca; pe Mine jura-va toată limba
translations.grk: Κατʼ ἐμαυτοῦ ὀμνύω, εἰ μὴ ἐξελεύσεται ἐκ τοῦ στόματός μου δικαιοσύνη, οἱ λόγοι μου οὐκ ἀποστραφήσονται· Ὅτι ἐμοὶ κάμψει πᾶν γόνυ, καὶ ὀμεῖται πᾶσα γλῶσσα τὸν Θεὸν,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ሊተ፡ ይሰግድ፡ ኵሉ፡ ብርክ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ልሳን፡ ይገኒ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: saying, Righteousness and glory shall come to him: and all that remove them from their borders shall be ashamed.

translations.lxx: saying, Righteousness and glory shall come to him: and all that remove them from their borders shall be ashamed.
translations.kjv: Surely, shall one say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
translations.ron: Şi va zice: "Numai în Domnul este dreptatea şi virtutea! Către Dânsul vor veni şi înfruntaţi vor fi cei ce sunt întărâtaţi împotriva Lui.
translations.grk: λέγων, δικαιοσύνη καὶ δόξα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἥξει, καὶ αἰσχυνθήσονται πάντες οἱ διορίζοντες αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ወይብል፤ ስብሐት፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ይምጽኡ፣፡ ወይትኀፈሩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይትረኃቁ፡ እምእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: By the Lord shall they be justified, and in God shall all the seed of the children of Israel be glorified.

translations.lxx: By the Lord shall they be justified, and in God shall all the seed of the children of Israel be glorified.
translations.kjv: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
translations.ron: Întru Domnul se vor îndrepta şi va fi preaslăvită toată seminţia lui Israel!"
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ Κυρίου δικαιωθήσονται, καὶ ἐν τῷ Θεῷ ἐνδοξασθήσεται πᾶν τὸ σπέρμα τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ይሴባሕ፡ ወይጸድቅ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘርአ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ በእግዚአብሔር።
